 Allies within 18 metres receive x1 Armor Charge.

 Grants x1 Armor Charge to Allies within 21 metres.

Name: Resistance
Description:
Grants 15% | 25% | 30% Damage Resist against Combatants.

Elemental Mods reduce Mod-Matching Elemental damage.
Sniper reduces damage from >30 metres.
Melee reduces damage from <5 metres.
Concussive Dampener reduces AoE/Blast/Explosive Damage.

Different Resist Mods, as well as other sources of Resist all stack multiplicatively with each other.

Name: Unflinching Aim
Description:
To Mod-Element Matching Weapons, while ADS:

Flinch Resistances are multiplicative with each other.

Name: Better Already
Description:

Begins Health Regeneration.

Mod does not stack, despite the in-game tooltip.

Name: Elemental Charge
Description:
Picking up Elemental Pickups, or destroying Tangles progresses a counter.

Grants x1 Armor Charge upon reaching 100% Counter Progress.

Elemental Pickup Counter Progress:
Void Breaches, Firesprites, and Tangles: 50% | 50% | 100%
Ionic Traces: 34% | 50% | 50% | Shards: 25% | 34% | 50%

Name: Enhanced Athletics
Description:
+30 | +50 | +60 Mobility.

Name: Holster
Description:
Stowed Weapons begin refilling after a period of time.

10% | 10% | 15% Magazine Refill per activation.

Does not work with Breech-Loaded Grenades Launchers, Crossbows, and Rocket Launchers.

Name: Recuperation

Restores 16 | 21 | 21 Health.

Name: Scavenger
Description:
On Ammo Brick Pickup to Mod-Element Matching Weapons:
Generally grants an additional +1 Ammo.

Machine Guns receive +7 Ammo.
Traces receive +10% Max Reserves.

By default, Ammo Bricks grant 25% to 33% of Reserves.
Works with Ammo Finder Bricks in full effect.

Does not function in PvP Game Modes.
